Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: `itemBasePremiumOf` in `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_11-43-59_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking/src/claim-office.ts` now throws `Error(\`Unknown item type: ${item.type}\`)` when the lookup in `BASE_PREMIUM_BY_ITEM_TYPE` yields `undefined`, instead of returning `undefined` and propagating `NaN`.

**Result**: All tests pass (29 passed, 22 todo).

**Approach**: This is minimal — a single guard at the exact point the prompt identified as the root cause. No validation pass, no error-type hierarchy, no aggregation of multiple unknown types, no changes to the claim-side paths that later tests will cover. The message interpolates `item.type` because the test asserts `/broomstick/`; a hardcoded string would not generalize past this one input and would be a worse minimal choice than the interpolation.

Proceeding to Refactor phase.
